Gameloft has renamed this game twice — Asphalt 9: Legends became Asphalt Legends Unite in 2024 and plain Asphalt Legends in 2025 — but the account, the garage and the Tokens are the same, and so is the top-up. Choose a Token Pack from the tiles, enter your Asphalt User ID at checkout and pick the platform you play on, pay in rupees with JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer, and the Tokens are credited to your account automatically, usually within minutes, confirmed in your order chat. No password, no login. Every tile shows its live PKR price.

## What a Token is worth spending on

Asphalt runs on two currencies. Credits come from racing and pay for ordinary upgrades; Tokens are the scarce one — the game hands out a few through events, and everything else is bought — and they unlock the things Credits can't touch: blueprints for the hypercars at the top of the garage, the premium card packs during Grand Prix and limited-time events, epic import parts and wild cards to finish an upgrade, refuels for a top-tier car mid-event, and tier jumps in the Legend Pass. Because Tokens are so hard to earn, the smart spend is the one that shortens a grind you'd never finish otherwise — a missing blueprint, a class pack — and no more.

## Platform matters here

The checkout asks which platform your account lives on — Android, iOS or Windows — because that's where Gameloft credits the Tokens. A Gameloft ID links progress across those three, so a Token top-up shows up on whichever of them you sign into. PlayStation, Switch and Xbox accounts are tied to their own store logins instead, and the platform list on this page doesn't include them; if you only race on a console, this top-up can't reach you. Pick the platform your account was created on.

## User ID, checked twice

Open Settings in the game and go to Customer Care — your User ID is printed there, and it's also on your player profile from the top bar of the main screen. Copy it rather than typing it, because a top-up sent to a wrong ID is credited to whoever owns that number, and neither we nor Gameloft can pull it back. Buying for a friend? Their User ID and platform go in the box instead of yours. Anything else — Tokens that haven't landed after a few minutes, a question about a pack — gets fixed fast in the order chat, and real reviews from delivered orders are further down this page.

## Asphalt token top-up FAQs

### What is the Asphalt Legends token price in Pakistan?

The live PKR price of every Token Pack is on the tiles above — we keep prices there rather than in text that goes stale. You pay in rupees with Pakistani payment methods, no dollar card needed.

### Where do I find my Asphalt User ID?

Settings, then Customer Care — the User ID is shown on that screen. It's also on your player profile from the main menu. Enter it at checkout exactly as shown, with the platform you play on.

### Is this the same game as Asphalt Legends Unite?

Yes. Asphalt 9: Legends, Asphalt Legends Unite and Asphalt Legends are one game under three names. Your account and Tokens carried through every rename, and these packs work on it.

### Does it work on PlayStation, Switch or Xbox?

No. The top-up credits Android, iOS and Windows accounts, which Gameloft ID links together. Console versions use the console's own store login and can't be reached by User ID.

### Do you need my password?

No. The Tokens are credited against your User ID from the supply side; your Gameloft, Google, Apple or Facebook login is never involved, and nobody honest will ask for it.

### The Tokens haven't arrived — what now?

Restart the game first; a credit sometimes needs a fresh login to display. Still missing after a few minutes? Message us in the order chat with your order number and we'll chase it. A wrong User ID or platform is the one case we can't reverse, so check both before you pay.
